_readme: Copy this file, replace the sites with sites you own, and run: npm run batch -- run <your file> .data/batch --allow-remote [--allow-active]. owned:true runs the probing Launch checks (private files, source maps, open tables): use it only for sites you own, and pass --allow-active to confirm that. planted is optional: list known problems on a site you control to measure what the tools miss.
name: owned sites
